title: Efficient hydrogenation of furfural to furfuryl alcohol by recoverable copper tailings catalyst
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,30949-30957
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01723A, Paper

Lele Shang, Weijun Dai, Xiaolong Hao, Dongbao Guo, Xiao Li, Yongjie Niu, Yalong Yi, Hao Wang, Xiaobo Pan, Shuang Dai
A recyclable copper tailings catalyst (CTC) achieves complete conversion of furan aldehydes and 80% selectivity for furfuryl alcohol within 72 h at 200 °C/3.0 MPa H2.
